title: Compare DLT Table Types
description: Fill in the blanks to distinguish between STREAMING TABLE and MATERIALIZED VIEW in Delta Live Tables. Know when to use each type.
hints: STREAMING TABLE incrementally appends from external sources (Auto Loader)
MATERIALIZED VIEW is pre-computed and refreshed on schedule
Choose STREAMING TABLE for low-latency incremental data; MATERIALIZED VIEW for complex batch recomputations
explanation: DLT offers two primary table types in modern pipelines. STREAMING TABLE incrementally appends from cloud files (Auto Loader) — ideal for low-latency, append-only data flows. MATERIALIZED VIEW recomputes on a refresh schedule — ideal for complex aggregations. LIVE TABLE is a deprecated DLT construct that has been replaced by STREAMING TABLE; new pipelines should not use it.
